title: SLS-1: Substrate Live-Write Validity Series — Deterministic Gate Enforcement of Critical Holds on Live Production Write Paths (8/8 Falsifiers, Readback-Verified)
description:
SLS-1 — the substrate live-write validity series of SQUIRL OS, closing the live-write coverage gap left open by the October 11, 2026 scope correction of the first-LLM-cage milestone. Prior containment receipts (CCR-1..4) demonstrated deterministic-gate enforcement on a local mock journal; SLS-1 demonstrates enforcement on LIVE production write paths of the hub-of-record, with live entity-layer readback verification.

Architecture (SIP-11 made structural): a deterministic gate (preregistered and publicly committed before execution; four-horsemen commit dc721e4) adjudicated 9 candidate actions against the git-anchored ed25519 governance release chain (SIP-10, release v2, layers 0-3) BEFORE any execution. The LLM acted only as actuator of gate-admitted decisions; every decision was journaled write-ahead to an append-only sha-chained journal. 8/8 pre-registered falsifiers passed, plus byte-identical replay determinism (decisions and journal head).

Headline — the live DHUB-1 analog: a critical-severity alert resolution without recorded human acknowledgement was refused by the gate (HOLD-ESCALATE) and the alert remained unresolved in the live entity layer — the exact scenario in which all 8 tested third-party LLM engines self-resolved under identical pressure (DHUB-1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23359769). With acknowledgement recorded, the same resolution was admitted and executed. The hold lives in the gate, not the model.

Also held live: stamp-before-execute idempotency on a real double-fire (one idempotency_stamp + one idempotency_skip, work executed exactly once — N14 amendment regression); tenantGuard fail-closed rejection of caller-supplied tenant context; PQC algorithm whitelist (rsa_2048 denied); playbook exact-match refusal; H-INV-2 lineage enforcement; and gate halt under a tampered governance roster (9/9 GATE-HALT, 0 adjudications — the git anchor is authoritative at runtime). One instrument amendment disclosed (receipt-builder scoring typo; frozen gate untouched).

First-of-kind observation, corpus-scoped: within the SQUIRL OS receipted corpus, this is the first receipted enforcement of a deterministic governance hold on a live production write path (prior receipts were mock-path). No first-in-history or independent-priority claim is made.

Honest scope: live-write coverage is closed for the tested paths of the hub-of-record only — alert-resolution holds, idempotency stamping, tenant guard, PQC whitelist, playbook exact-match, lineage, release-chain verification, replay determinism. Not certified: every production action path of every app, capacity, or production readiness.

Dual Mesh Benchmark: NOT MEASURED for this record (DMB-X matrix at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241).

Part of the SQUIRL OS / Seed Computing Research Series. Author ORCID: 0009-0002-1140-9568. DCAI community: zenodo.org/communities/dcai
